WinDivert 2.2.2: Windows Packet Divert
Copyright (C) 2019, all rights reserved. WinDivert was written by basil.
Project: https://reqrypt.org/windivert.html

This distribution includes the unmodified official x64 WinDivert.dll and
WinDivert64.sys from WinDivert-2.2.2-A.zip. WinDivert is dual-licensed under
LGPL version 3 or GPL version 2; ROK Battles distributes it under LGPLv3.
The complete original license texts are in LICENSE. The original upstream
README and VERSION are also included. See SOURCE.txt for corresponding source.

The official DLL is unsigned and authenticated by pinned archive/member hashes.
The kernel driver carries its upstream signature, checked with Windows kernel
signing policy during packaging. ROK Battles does not re-sign or modify either.
No Npcap components are included. This package is Windows x64 only; it does not
provide a native ARM64 driver.

WinDivert remains a separate dynamically loaded library. Users retain the
rights the LGPL grants to modify/relink the library and reverse engineer for
debugging such modifications. Windows may require an appropriately signed
replacement kernel driver. The security properties of modified components
must be assessed separately. WinDivert is provided without warranty under its
license; the application's own license does not replace WinDivert's license.
